info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update It Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Technology Standards Management API enables businesses to update specific IT management standards using precise parameters. This endpoint allows for fine-tuning of existing technology standards, ensuring alignment with evolving business needs. Typical consumers include IT managers and compliance officers who require the ability to adjust specifications based on current organizational directives. By using this API, organizations can maintain up-to-date compliance with technology standards while optimizing their internal governance processes.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of the technology standard identified by RES-100045. Ensure that you provide the required information in the request body to successfully perform the update.

requestBody.description: Request body for updating the technology standards associated with resource RES-100045. This includes modifications to various properties of the existing standards.
